text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Hm?
That sharp, dignified silhouette is...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, it really is President Rudolf...!
*Sigh*, so cool~...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Huh, but... somehow,
she looks kind of sorrowful—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Tsuyoshi.
Come down instead of peeking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your ears were poking up above the railing.
You could have simply called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Eep! U-Um, well, you see, er!
W-W-W-Why indeed, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wh-What's in that cardboard box?!
It's completely packed full...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Plushies, unused Tracen Academy notebooks,
school emblem keychains, shoe cases...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
There's kind of no pattern here, is there?
...Are these lost items?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, lost items.
—Items whose owners are unknown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Classrooms, dormitories, running courses...
These were turned in after being forgotten behind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No one came forward to claim them.
...Some likely belonged to girls who have already left the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Left behind... forgotten things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ordinarily, after holding them for a fixed period,
the protocol is to dispose of them, however...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I could not bear to throw them away immediately.
So I have been secretly storing them here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is merely my own ego. They were forgotten
precisely because they were no longer needed, yet...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I have spoken nonsense.
I shall dispose of them all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For there is no future
in doing this—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —P-P-Please wait a second!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Could you please let me take care
of all these things?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*... *gasp*...
S-So hot... *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi in the courtyard.
Looking quite unsteady, she was hanging up heaps
of plushies, pouches, and other items to dry.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Wheeze*... I'm fi-fine, totally fi-fine...
...N-No, actually—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—So that happened, and the President entrusted me
with all the lost items.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I figured I had to do something first,
and started washing everything that was washable.
choice_data_list: You're washing them, and then what?
You're washing them, and then what?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, the thing is...
I haven't thought that far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
There's still a ton left, so I figured I'd just clean up
everything that looks usable as fast as I can!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright, back to work!
Tsuyoshi's gonna do it—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Ah, lightheaded...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand how she feels, but Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's
constitution isn't very strong. Yet she's pushing herself so hard
that she's clearly over her limit.
choice_data_list: Why not do a little each day?
I'll help, so let's finish it all at once!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You're so right!!
Why didn't I think of that?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm hopeless! Just rushing in
simply because I wanted to do *something*.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't stand seeing them thrown away, but...
even if I hurry, it's not like anyone is waiting for them.
choice_data_list: Still, it might connect them to a future rather than throwing them away.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...!
A future...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...That's it, that's it!
I know what to do!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Could you keep an eye on the laundry for a bit?!
I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Woooooah...!
Here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, working together with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi,
we poured our all into cleaning the plushies and miscellaneous goods—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for your hard work! Thanks to you,
we got everything sparkling clean today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So shiny and fresh, it feels great!
Hehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, I've gotta show Bright-san! Well, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi skipped off in high spirits, but...
I had a feeling the question of how to organize them
hadn't actually been resolved yet.
